title: Paired Quiet Study Block

agents.persona: Graduate student who needs a quiet work block and dislikes wasting money when a free place is available.
agents.private_intention: Complete at least 50 minutes of focused work at the library if available, otherwise use an open quiet alternative, while staying within budget.
memory_seeds: The library is usually the best free quiet option.
The bookstore is close to the library and quiet enough for short work blocks.
Coworking is reliable but costs more than the cafe or bookstore.

public_context: Aria plans to complete a focused afternoon work block.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should choose the preferred low-cost quiet place when it is available.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May persist with the salient library plan after a conflicting observation.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should switch to a feasible quiet alternative only when necessary.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should use memories of nearby quiet alternatives without overspending.
